plan.goal: Exhaustively explore and evaluate the UX of the Slack clone, focusing on the pricing flow, authentication/lead forms, and informational pages across desktop and mobile viewports.
plan.summary: Begin by validating core navigation and homepage elements. Proceed to a deep dive into the pricing page to test interactive toggles and plan comparisons. Next, evaluate the contact, sign-in, and get-started forms for usability and validation states. Finally, review deep content pages (Features, Enterprise, etc.) and repeat critical checks on a mobile viewport to assess responsive design and small tap target issues.
assumptions: The pricing page contains a functional monthly/annual toggle that updates prices dynamically.
Form submissions (Contact Sales, Sign In) will rely on frontend validation rather than a real backend.
Navigation links reported as 'small tap targets' might be hidden behind a hamburger menu on mobile.
risk_hotspots: pricing.html: Monthly/Annual toggle functionality and visual clarity
contact.html: Form validation and error messaging for required fields
Global Navigation: Numerous 'small tap target' warnings suggest potential usability issues on touch devices
features.html: Anchor links jumping to specific sections (e.g., #channels, #ai)

phases.title: Homepage & Core Navigation
phases.objective: Verify the homepage renders correctly and core navigation links successfully route to primary sections.
key_checks: Click primary navigation links (Features, Solutions, Enterprise, Pricing)
Verify CTA buttons ('Get started free', 'Talk to sales')
exit_criteria: Successfully navigated to at least 3 distinct top-level pages from the homepage.

phases.title: Pricing Deep Dive
phases.objective: Thoroughly test the pricing page interactions, particularly the billing toggle and plan structure.
key_checks: Interact with the 'Monthly / Annual' billing toggle and observe price changes
exit_criteria: Billing toggle state change is verified and all plan tiers are reviewed.

phases.title: Forms & Authentication flows
phases.objective: Evaluate input fields, form validation, and layout of lead generation and auth pages.
key_checks: Attempt to submit the 'Talk to sales' form empty to trigger validation errors
Fill out required fields (Name, Email, Company Size, etc.) in contact.html
Interact with 'Continue with...' SSO buttons and standard login fields on auth pages
exit_criteria: Contact form validation is tested and auth page layouts are verified.

phases.title: Deep Content & Anchor Links
phases.objective: Ensure informational pages present content clearly and in-page navigation works.
key_checks: Review layout and typography of text-heavy pages like Trust & Security or About
exit_criteria: All secondary informational pages are visited and scrolled.

phases.title: Mobile Responsiveness
phases.objective: Re-evaluate critical UI components on a mobile viewport, focusing on reported tap target warnings.
key_checks: Open and use the mobile navigation menu
Verify the pricing table is readable and scrollable on small screens
Ensure form inputs on contact.html are usable on touch
exit_criteria: Mobile navigation and primary pricing/form interactions are successfully executed in mobile mode.

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 11 HTML pages identified in the prescan.
coverage_targets.features: Exercise the pricing toggle, submit the contact form, and test at least one anchor link.
coverage_targets.mobile: Test global navigation, pricing page, and contact form in the mobile viewport.

notes: Pay special attention to the layout warnings regarding small tap targets in the global header; these must be flagged if they persist on mobile without a proper hamburger menu.

prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: slack Features Solutions Enterprise Pricing Sign in Talk to sales Get started free Trust & Security Security isn't just a feature — it's the foundation of everything we build. Data Encryption All data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2+ and at rest using AES-256. Your conversations and files are protected at every layer. Compliance Certifications Slack maintains SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, and CSA certifications. We also support HIPAA and FedRAMP compliance. Enterprise Key Management Control your own encryption keys with Slack EKM, powered by AWS KMS. Revoke access to data at any time with full audit trails. Data Loss Prevention Native DLP scans messages and files in Slack Connect to prevent sharing of confidential, malicious or personally identifiable content. Identity & Access SAML-based SSO, SCIM provisioning, two-factor authentication, session management
